answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 314 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is recorded in the delta index and the pigment audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the nadir beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 6 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
